product-plane-speeds.scope: A dimension-independent bridge from membership in the actual signed/permuted rational span of (W,0) and the last coordinate axis to the full positive integer speed list (A W,b), retaining multiplicities and permutation. A base coordinate equal to one proves integrality of the scale. For a primitive actual speed list below 1/q, with q at least four and every base residue nonzero modulo q, the existing unbounded product-family arithmetic forces the exact family W ++ [q*s] with s positive. No geometric exhaustiveness, numerical coverage, or unconditional spectrum classification is claimed.

seven-eight.scope: Unconditional realization of every proposed seven- and eight-speed spectrum value. Sharp maximum-speed bounds with factors 13/5 and 21/17 on every stated family and all 44 sporadic rows, including permutations and every positive-denominator representation of the exact value. Membership in the listed families is explicit; classification of arbitrary speed tuples remains unproved. The exact value set within the stated candidates and its reduced numerator/denominator alternatives are also proved.

seven-low-gap.scope: The seven-speed low-gap input used in the eight-coordinate plane argument. Within the stated seven-speed candidates, values below 3/23 have exactly the three literal base speed lists and equal 1/8. An explicit primitive seven-speed classification hypothesis extends this conclusion to arbitrary positive distinct seven-speed lists, with the positive gcd scaling retained. The primitive classification itself is not proved or assumed as an axiom.

six-arithmetic.scope: Exact reduced rational forms of the proposed six-speed spectrum and unconditional realization of each reduced family. Odd denominator and gap one or three are proved necessary, with an explicit counterexample to their sufficiency. This does not prove exhaustive classification of all six-speed tuples. The exact nine sporadic sextuples also have their stated values, the required parameter form, speed below three times every positive representing denominator, and reduced denominator six times the numerator plus one. Permutations are allowed; off-list exhaustiveness remains separate.

six-fields-product.scope: The exact 80 signed triple factors and a finite sufficient checker for nonzero raw residue sextuples, including repetitions, at threshold 1/6. Two distinct factor indices give prime-square divisibility, including equal evaluated integers; the squared speed product covers primes dividing a coordinate. The actual squared norm bounds the whole obstruction, so P^4 > N^12*(3*N)^80 forces an additive relation on three pairwise distinct coordinate indices. PrimeTriangleCover remains an explicit hypothesis for each counted prime. Its two-distinct-factors criterion is weaker than the original C++ distinct-folded-value criterion; no orbit coverage, numerical prime certificate, distinctness of speed values, or universal spectrum classification is claimed.

six-plane-data-pilots.scope: The complete 10-pattern coordinate-permutation lookup coverage, checked through 120 bounded 60-rank blocks and a proved quotient/remainder join. The 32-, 256-, and 1280-case certificate pilots are also checked. Generic finite certificate joins cover every row for any positive chunk size with blocks times size equal to 360; their complete numerical chunk checks remain explicit inputs. This task does not claim full finite candidate-pair coverage or unconditional plane classification.

six-plane-semantics.scope: Six-coordinate rational-plane normalization, repeated-direction and no-identical-coordinate lemmas, finite certificate semantics, and recognition of the three literal critical planes up to coordinate signs and permutations. The four-speed runner bound, exact five-speed low-gap classification, and complete checked candidate-pair coverage remain explicit theorem inputs; no numerical finite coverage or unconditional plane classification is claimed. The exact five-speed low-gap hypothesis is additionally derived from the existing literal SporadicExhaustion statement. All 720 permutation ranks are checked, and abstract numerical direction coverage plus row/block certificate checks imply full CandidatePairsChecked; the numerical coverage and block checks themselves are not supplied here.

triangles.scope: Actual integer-distance-graph triangle witnesses for the literal six-speed product and signed third families, all nine six-speed sporadics, the stated seven- and eight-speed families, and all 44 higher sporadics. Gcd normalization transports witnesses. The six-, seven- and eight-distance Zhu consequences are proved from explicitly stated primitive near-tight classification hypotheses. Exhaustive classification and finite coverage remain separate obligations.
